text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki let victory slip away... Her 
struggle was likely partly due to issues 
with distance aptitude.

Thus, the defeat wasn't anything to 
despair over, but she lamented that she 
had shown a shameful performance. She was 
unable to kindle her fighting spirit, 
after all.

The Trainer points out that the cause 
might be the absence of Mejiro Ardan and 
Sakura Chiyono O.

Back during the Japanese Derby, she burned 
with a fierce desire not to lose to the 
other two. But right now, she hasn't 
reached that level of "obsession."

However, "obsession" was merely an extra 
bonus. Setting her sights on the Osaka Hai 
as her next goal, Yaeno Muteki resolved to 
keep training diligently as always.
